VR.title: Fanmade VR Port Of Nintendo 64 Classic Perfect Dark Out Now On Quest & PC
VR.summary: A fanmade VR port of the Nintendo 64 classic Perfect Dark is now available for Quest and PC, marking a significant addition for retro gaming enthusiasts.

VR.title: Official Discord App Finally Comes to Quest After Years of Waiting
VR.summary: Discord has officially launched its app for Quest, fulfilling a long-standing request from users for integrated communication on the platform.

VR.title: Apple's Vision Pro & Glasses Hardware Chief Leaves For OpenAI
VR.summary: Apple's Vision Pro hardware chief has left the company to join OpenAI, signaling potential shifts in leadership and innovation in AR/VR technology.

VR.title: Quest’s Most Popular Game ‘Gorilla Tag’ is Going Mobile in ‘Monke Mayhem’ Next Year
VR.summary: Quest's most popular game, Gorilla Tag, will expand to mobile devices next year with a standalone title called Gorilla Tag: Monke Mayhem.

VR.title: Cyberpunk 2077 is getting the VR mod fans have wanted for years
VR.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 is set to receive a long-awaited VR mod, enhancing the immersive experience of its vibrant and detailed world.

VR.title: Meta’s Brain AI Takes a Step Closer to Telepathy With Improved Thought-to-Text Decoding
VR.summary: Meta has unveiled an upgraded brain-computer interface capable of decoding brain activity into text, aiding those with speech impairments.

AI.title: OpenAI is teasing new hardware… for Codex
AI.summary: OpenAI is set to release new hardware related to its AI coding tool, Codex, on July 15, enhancing user experience with upgraded shortcuts.

AI.title: Anthropic’s long-sidelined Fable 5 is greenlit to return
AI.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 has been greenlit to return online after negotiations with the Trump administration, restoring access to users globally.

AI.summary: Tidal will label AI-generated music tracks starting July 15, aiming to protect artists while allowing AI content on its platform.

AI.title: Lawmakers want to ban AI companies from selling your health data

AI.title: Google’s NotebookLM can sum up your research in a TikTok-style clip

NFL.title: Calais Cambell's mother dead, brother charged

NFL.title: 6-foot-9, 268-pound Aussie Ben Te Kura quits rugby to pursue NFL career

NFL.summary: The Lions have released cornerback Terrion Arnold following his arrest on felony charges, marking a significant disciplinary action by the team.

NFL.title: Texans waive DB Ajani Carter, LB Xavier Thomas off of IR
